badges.text: §c§lfigura_1:§r§f Primary ability, howl as the hunt begins. 1 second long.
§c§lfigura_2:§r§f Primary ability, on the hunt. Plays for the duration of the buff.
§c§lfigura_3:§r§f Secondary ability, sprinting or swimming quickly. Plays for the duration.
§c§lfigura_4:§r§f Underdog triggers when you reach 0 HP. 1 second long.
§c§lfigura_5:§r§f Secondary ability, pouncing. Up to 2 seconds long, ends when you touch the floor.

name: Figura Compatibility
description: Numbered Figura hooks remain supported for existing avatars. New avatars should use the semantic state names and Lua helper documented in FIGURA_COMPAT.md.
